description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single ranged attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Water], [Physical Blink 1] and [Torrent Blade Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Physical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next PHY attack that deals physical, missing HP or fixed damage or NAT attack that deals physical or fractional damage

description.name: Torrent Blade Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Torrent Blade after using a Water ability
